paragraphs: Early in the morning, review the day's farewell schedule and assign celebrants, vehicles, and reception staff. Meet families to confirm the process, explain fees, and provide comfort. At midday, check compliance and sanitation. Spend the afternoon on accounts, purchasing, and training, then inspect the venue before leaving to ensure the next day is ready.
